scenario.label: Severe heat + hazardous air pollution
scenario.summary: A stagnant, near-windless spell traps dust and combustion PM2.5 under strong heat. Tmax approaches 48 °C in the densest zones (a severe heatwave episode on Days +2 to +5) WHILE PM2.5 peaks push the indicative Indian AQI into the 400s. The joint heat+air load band reaches Severe, lifting recommended actions a level.
scenario.tagline: Compound exposure: the joint heat+air load escalates.
teaching_points: Concentration AQI stays separate from the parameterised joint load
Stagnant wind raises both WBGT (less convective cooling) and PM2.5
Escalation rule: severe air load + thermal ≥ warning ⇒ severe alert level
